This release fixes a few bugs in Daybar 1.0.0.

## Fixes

- Quick add keeps words like breakfast, lunch, and dinner in the title. Before, "Dinner Fri 7pm" created an event with no title.
- Quick add colors now stay on the right words while you type. They no longer lag behind or linger after you delete text.
- An event's alerts are listed nearest first, in the same order every time.
- The panel's shadow follows its rounded bottom corners instead of showing square edges.

## Install

Download `Daybar.dmg` below, open it, and drag Daybar to your Applications folder, replacing the old version. Daybar needs macOS 27 or later.

The app and disk image are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. To check your download, compare it with `Daybar.dmg.sha256`, or verify its build provenance:

```sh
gh attestation verify Daybar.dmg --repo firatciftci/daybar
```
